Delta node architecture

Delta is operated by NCSA · University of Illinois in United States. This profile covers the documented compute inventory.

Scope and uncertainty

Compute-node counts follow individual specification tables. The operator page's introductory large-memory count is inconsistent with those tables.

Not verified means a detail has not been confirmed in this catalog. Diagrams are schematic; node indices are illustrative, not physical hostnames. Data checked 13 September 2026.
